item.title: Canada's World Cup Dream Hinges on Alphonso Davies' Fitness
item.description: Canada's men's team is aiming for glory on home soil in the 2026 World Cup, but all eyes are on star player Alphonso Davies as he battles to prove his fitness.

item.title: Graceland Snaps Up ShedSync to Turbocharge Dealer Digital Dreams
item.description: Portable building giant Graceland buys tech startup ShedSync to give dealers a high-tech makeover with AI marketing and automated inventory.

item.title: India Still World's Fastest-Growing Economy, But Slowdown Looms!
item.description: India is set to remain the fastest-growing major economy, but World Bank warns growth will slip to 6.6% next fiscal amid rising energy prices.

item.title: Crypto Scores Big: Kraken, Chiliz, Avalanche Join World Cup 2026
item.description: FIFA locks in crypto giants Kraken, Chiliz, and Avalanche as World Cup 2026 sponsors. Could this be the kickoff for mainstream crypto adoption?

item.title: Transformers-Inspired Moon Rover Finally Reveals Its Lunar Secrets!
item.description: Japan's adorable ball-shaped robot rover, inspired by Transformers, has finally shared data from its historic lunar crawl two years after landing.
